shared_elements: low-relief figures carved on an upright stone surface
horizontal band of small repeated marks/signs
figural imagery confined to an upper zone with a differently treated lower zone
arch-topped or rounded upper framing shapes
justification: The only real correspondences are generic: both are upright carved surfaces divided into an upper figural zone above a band of small repeated signs, with a rounded/arched motif at the top. The depicted subjects differ almost entirely — A shows schematic profile animals (birds, quadruped, snake) and abstract H-like symbols, while B shows a row of small standing human figures above dense rows of inscribed text, with no animals or shared postures or attributes.
